title: can1357/oh-my-pi
friendlyTitle: Oh My Pi: an open coding agent for your terminal
summary: Oh My Pi is a terminal coding agent with hash-anchored edits, language-server support, browser tooling, Python execution and subagents. The actively updated project has more than 21,000 GitHub stars.
friendlySummary: This popular project lets an AI read and change code, use a browser, run Python and call smaller helper agents.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it as an open-source coding-agent workbench, especially when they want terminal-native workflows, precise edits and access to several tools in one harness.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Try it if you want a flexible coding helper that works from the command line.
